common.name: Vacuum Card
common.description: Vacuum card allows you to control your robot vacuum.

error.rooms_not_mapped: These rooms are not mapped to Home Assistant areas: {rooms}. Map the vacuum's segments to areas in its entity settings, then try again.
error.area_mapping_unsupported: This vacuum doesn't support Home Assistant's segment-to-area mapping, so room icons can't be looked up. Update Valetudo and Home Assistant, then try again.

warning.actions_array: WARNING: 'actions' is reserved to override default actions for existing buttons. If your intention was to add additional actions, use the 'shortcuts' option instead.

editor.code_only_note: Note: Setting actions and stats options are available exclusively using Code Editor.
editor.room_shortcuts_help: Adds a shortcut for each room in {sensor}, replacing existing shortcuts for the same robot's room cleaning topic.
editor.map_rooms_prompt: Some rooms are not mapped to areas yet. In the dialog that opened, choose "Map vacuum segments to areas", save, then close the dialog to generate the shortcuts.
